dictionary.title: Security & Firewall
dictionary.description: NetGuard, ARP inspection and firewall rules
dictionary.confirm_message: Change applied: confirm it within {seconds} s or it will be rolled back.
dictionary.mode_monitor_hint: Logs suspicious traffic without blocking it.
dictionary.mode_protect_hint: Blocks unsolicited traffic and detected attacks.
dictionary.alerts_empty: No alerts: the network is quiet.
dictionary.engine_offline: The attack detector is not connected.
dictionary.autonomy_label: How much it does on its own
dictionary.autonomy_observe_hint: Detects and shows attacks but blocks nothing.
dictionary.autonomy_assist_hint: Applies only light defences and warns you about the others.
dictionary.autonomy_autonomous_hint: Blocks, slows down or isolates the attacker. Every defence is temporary and you can undo it.
dictionary.option_tarpit_hint: Suspicious connections are kept slow instead of blocked.
dictionary.option_honeypot_hint: Hostile traffic is diverted to a fake service on the device, with no access to your network.
dictionary.option_quarantine_hint: A home device sending data suspiciously is isolated.
dictionary.option_country_block_hint: If too many attacks come from one country I block it for a while. Never your own countries.
dictionary.option_geo_updates_hint: Downloads the address-to-country list every month; lookups stay on the device.
dictionary.country_threshold: Attacks from one country before blocking
dictionary.max_actions: Automatic defences per hour at most
dictionary.home_countries_hint: Two-letter codes separated by spaces, for example IT CH.
dictionary.geo_missing: Country list not downloaded yet: the country of attacks is unknown.
dictionary.trusted_hint: A trusted device is never blocked by automatic defences. Adding one needs a confirmation code.
dictionary.trusted_confirm: You are about to trust {{address}}. Type this code to confirm:
dictionary.trusted_accept_risks: I understand the risks and want to proceed
dictionary.risk_internet: This is an Internet address, not one from your home.
dictionary.risk_wide_network: This is a very wide network, not a single device.
